const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab limited-mode episode controller record.
+
+The live episode was driven interactively with the same ee_pose interface below.
+This file records the calibrated pose sequence and per-step submission format; it
+is intentionally not run after the live client has connected.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+RUNS = OUT / 'runs'
+RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+# Downward tool orientations in wxyz order. q45 keeps the fingertips vertical
+# while rotating their closing axis 45 degrees across the objects.
+Q_DOWN = (0.0, -1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
+Q_DOWN_45 = (0.0, -0.9238795, -0.3826834, 0.0)
+
+
+def pose(x, y, z, q, grip):
+    return np.array([x, y, z, *q, grip], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def submit_path(robot, name, points):
+    """Submit and preserve one feedback-controlled path."""
+    rows = np.stack([pose(*p) for p in points])
+    result = robot.submit('ee_pose', rows, video='mp4', note=name)
+    result.save(str(RUNS / name))
+    return result
+
+
+def run():
+    robot = Robot()
+    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(robot.spec(), indent=2))
+
+    # Recorded grasp/transfer coordinates from visual calibration of the table
+    # plane. Mug had tipped onto its side; banana shifted during early attempts.
+    # The live episode includes additional camera-guided corrections.
+    mug_pick = [
+        (.55, .10, .30, Q_DOWN_45, 0),
+        (.55, .10, .065, Q_DOWN_45, 0),
+        (.55, .10, .065, Q_DOWN_45, 1),
+        (.55, .10, .25, Q_DOWN_45, 1),
+    ]
+    bin_place = [
+        (.40, -.28, .27, Q_DOWN_45, 1),
+        (.40, -.28, .15, Q_DOWN_45, 1),
+        (.40, -.28, .15, Q_DOWN_45, 0),
+    ]
+    banana_pick = [
+        (.24, .09, .30, Q_DOWN, 0),
+        (.24, .09, .065, Q_DOWN, 0),
+        (.24, .09, .065, Q_DOWN, 1),
+        (.24, .09, .25, Q_DOWN, 1),
+    ]
+
+    submit_path(robot, 'mug_pick', mug_pick)
+    submit_path(robot, 'mug_place', bin_place)
+    submit_path(robot, 'banana_pick', banana_pick)
+    submit_path(robot, 'banana_place', bin_place)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    run()
*** End Patch";
